titles.english: The Boundary between Dream and Reality

description:
The main character, Kengo, keeps having dreams of a strange world where different animal (and plant) women are being raped by strange monsters. Why is this and what is this strange dream world?

Before long it will become more than just a mere dream...

(Source: AniDB)
